episode.title: Something Is WRONG With This ICE CUBE

synopsis: A man takes one ice cube out for his coffee and the cube holds its sharp square edges while frost blooms outward across the warm kitchen counter.
narration: Grabbed ice for my coffee and the whole counter went white around it. Landlord thinks I left the freezer open. Should I call someone?

shots.prompt: A single clear ice cube with sharp square edges and a faintly frosted surface. frost spreading outward from the ice in fine white feathers across the warm stone. The frame remains completely locked from a tight low angle across the kitchen counter. A lived-in home kitchen counter: dark speckled stone-look surface with faint scratches and a few crumbs near the edge, a tiled backsplash behind, and morning daylight from a side window mixing with a warm under-cabinet glow. Hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt rest on the counter beside the ice, the cube filling the centre of the frame. The ice holds its sharp square edges while a widening ring of white frost around the sharp cube creeps further over the dry warm stone, bright and even under the morning daylight.
shots.violation_observation: the ice holds its sharp square edges while frost widens across the warm stone
shots.state_carry: a widening ring of white frost around the sharp cube
